node.label: Gaucher disease
node.definition: Gaucher disease (GD) is a lysosomal storage disorder encompassing three main forms (types 1, 2 and 3), a fetal form and a variant with cardiac involvement (Gaucher disease - ophthalmoplegia - cardiovascular calcification or Gaucher-like disease).

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
